**The situation** — what you are trying to notice while a model is running.

**How you would read it instead**

TokenSpeed is deliberately narrow: one machine, one Strata server, "see the
current tok/s at a glance". Historical graphs, multi-host dashboards and alerting
are out of scope by design, so please say what problem a request solves rather
than only the UI you have in mind.
